videos
Published on Jul 30, 2026 09:28 am IST
Share Via
Copy Link
A newly released animation offers a glimpse into the planned $22 billion transformation of Washington Dulles International Airport. The ambitious redevelopment project aims to modernise terminals, expand passenger capacity, and enhance travel infrastructure at one of America's busiest aviation hubs.
